title: 当飞鸟划过天空
lyrics:
[00:00.000] 作曲 Composer : jkinss
[00:00.894] 编曲 Arranger : jkinss
[00:01.788] 作词 Lyricist : Xulai
[00:02.682] 演唱 Vocal : Celine/VISION SOUND
[00:03.576] 混音 Mixing Engineer : 张步若@RSS Studio
[00:04.470] 乐器独奏Solo : Guitar
[00:05.364] 吉他编写 Guitar Composing : jkinss/愤怒的糖
[00:06.258] 母带工程 Mastering Engineer : 张步若@RSS Studio
[00:07.152] 监制 Music Supervisor : jixwang
[00:08.046] 出品 Produced by : 鸣潮先约电台
[00:08.942]Birds please
[00:10.332]send this song to the souls
[00:14.048]who are weighed down by grief yet find the strength to believe
[00:21.383]Weave a dream with me
[00:25.009]on the tapestry of tides
[00:28.689]Strum my strings
[00:30.555]for the endless dance of time
[00:37.041]To fly is not to flee
[00:39.828]But to journey towards the dreams
[00:42.976]All the hopes will set us free
[00:45.473]from doubts and fears deep within
[00:48.631]Let the sunrise gild our wings
[00:51.292]Let the twilight soothe our skin
[00:54.070]In the sky we're forever wild and free

[01:30.705]But to journey towards the dreams
